findings.summary: ALL is single-source but the regex requires a trailing comma and rejects digits, so three legal edits to settings.gradle.kts still drop a module silently while the gate prints a count.
findings.failure_scenario: Append `"wal"` as the last include() entry WITHOUT a trailing comma (or name it `binstore-v2`, or write `include("format", "wal")` on one line). The derivation regex yields the other modules only, so the [ -n "$ALL" ] guard still passes. GATE_SCOPE=full then checks 7 and prints `7 module(s) checked`; the delta path never maps `wal/` to a module; and `check-module.sh wal` still fails loudly with `unknown module: wal` -- a silent-skip-plus-loud-CLI asymmetry. Widening to '^[[:space:]]*"[a-z][a-z0-9-]*",?' or deriving from `./gradlew -q projects` closes it. Carried forward unchanged from 81996e91; check-module.sh is byte-identical.
